name: connector-zendesk
description: Zendesk Support customer-service platform. REST/JSON API (api/v2) over per-tenant `https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com` with Basic auth (email/token). Covers 99 objects — tickets, users, organizations, groups, ticket fields/forms/metrics, macros/triggers/automations, help center (articles/sections/categories/comments), custom objects + records/fields, talk/chat/routing, and audit streams. Cursor + offset pagination, Incremental Export watermark sync, full read + write, sample-union discovery.
